other_attempts.detail: The imported click oracle expected source identity through an initial load fade. Source8 explicitly verifies unavailable identity during the fade and source-qualified identity after it settles.

limits: No physical USB controller, external audio, converter/display alignment, listening or hardware XRUN qualification.
The transition timing fixture stores 64 tracks/32768 notes per graph; only eight clip tracks and two decks per graph are active. It does not qualify maximum polyphony or all 128 tracks active.
Each timing trial measures the first 256 callbacks of a 30-second fade and ends through safety silence. Ordinary fixtures separately check complete fade and delayed outgoing effect tails.
Process RSS/HWM are snapshots from /proc/self/status; the highest observed value is not a proven memory ceiling. Preparation timing excludes native-container I/O.
The live-set route is standard stereo outputs1/2 with optional independent cue3/4; custom-route handoff remains open.
No published or installed package, closed backlog or complete hardware acceptance claim.
